marca.frase: Break into and fix Row Level Security policies, against a real Postgres running in your tab.
inicio.texto: Each level is a fake app with a real Row Level Security flaw. You get in through it as any ordinary visitor would. Then you close the hole in SQL, without taking the app down.
inicio.garantia: Everything runs in your browser. No third-party database is touched.
schema.nota: What the API exposes to any visitor.
dicas.custo: Each hint you open costs one star.
ataque.saidaVazia: The app's responses show up here.
defesa.legendaErrado: differs from what it should be
defesa.testesVazio: Run the tests to see whether your fix closes the hole without breaking the app.
defesa.sqlDesatualizado: The SQL has changed since the last test run.
inicio.trancada: Beat the previous level, in any mode, to unlock this one.
inicio.laboratorioTexto: Free mode, always open: write tables and policies and see right away what each user can see.
ciclo.avancar: Now fix what you broke into
ciclo.seuAtaque: The attack you just ran joined the test suite: {n} call(s). Your attack became a test.
lab.nota: Updates as you type. Dimmed rows are the ones this user can't see.
perfil.soNoNavegador: Your progress is stored only in this browser. If you clear the site's data, it's gone.
perfil.anonima: You're playing without an account. Your progress is already saved, but tied to this browser. Sign in with Google to take it to other devices; nothing you've done is lost.
perfil.vinculada: Your progress is saved to this account. Sign in with it on another device to pick up where you left off. If you sign out, this browser goes back to the start, and your progress waits for you in the account.

inicio.tudoVencido: You've beaten everything there is. Come back for the stars you're missing, or head to the Lab.
inicio.modos: How do you want to play
inicio.modoAtaque: You're an ordinary visitor. Make the target row show up in a response in your console.
inicio.modoDefesa: Fix the policies in SQL without breaking the app. The test suite decides.
inicio.modoCiclo: Attack and then fix the same level. Your attack becomes a test for your fix.
trilha.sub: Each dot is an app with a flaw. Beat one, in any mode, and the next one opens.
trilha.aCaminhoTexto: Tier 4, with a SQL console: the owner that doesn't obey RLS and search_path hijacking.
cena.alvo: you weren't meant to see this
cena.descricao: Animated demo of level 1. In the attack, a select with no login returns every order, including Bruno's order 7, which wasn't supposed to show up. In the defense, a per-owner policy closes the leak and all 17 tests pass.
bateria.uso.vazio: the call didn't fail, but returned nothing
resposta.texto: In this level the row never shows up. Work out the hidden value and enter it here.
diario.texto: A new level every day, drawn from the date: a different flaw, app and target. It's the same for everyone, and tomorrow it's gone.
diario.feitoHoje: Today's is done. Come back tomorrow.
diario.naoPerca: Play today's to keep your streak.
diario.troca: The challenge changes at midnight, your time.
trilha.escolha: Tap a dot to see the level.
mapa.sub: Each island is an app with a flaw. Beat one, in any mode, and the route lights up to the next.
perfil.ceu: Each level is a constellation of nine stars, three per mode. The ones you've earned are lit in the sky behind this page.
